# RinVita

> RinVita is a private medical records hub for internationally mobile people and families. It keeps a person's lifelong health history in one place, organised and tracked over time, with AI translation as one feature and secure sharing whenever a clinician needs it.

RinVita Ltd is a UK company (registered in England and Wales, number 17163153), ICO registered (ZC123014). All infrastructure is hosted in the EU (Ireland). Data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. The service is designed with UK GDPR principles in mind; health data is processed with the user's explicit consent, and the legal basis and condition for processing are kept under review. RinVita does not currently offer zero-knowledge/end-to-end encryption.

## Free medical document translator

- [Translate a medical document](/translate): Free AI translation of a medical document plus a plain-English summary, 45+ languages, no account required.
- [Polish medical records to English](/translate/polish-medical-records-to-english): Translate Polish lab results, wypis discharge summaries and vaccination records, with a Polish medical term glossary.
- [Romanian medical records to English](/translate/romanian-medical-records-to-english): Translate Romanian analize, bilet de externare and vaccination records, with a Romanian glossary.
- [Spanish medical records to English](/translate/spanish-medical-records-to-english): Translate Spanish analítica, informe de alta and cartilla de vacunación, with a Spanish glossary.
- [Portuguese medical records to English](/translate/portuguese-medical-records-to-english): Translate Portuguese and Brazilian hemograma, laudo and sumário de alta, with a Portuguese glossary.
- [Italian medical records to English](/translate/italian-medical-records-to-english): Translate Italian referto, lettera di dimissione and libretto delle vaccinazioni, with an Italian glossary.
- [French medical records to English](/translate/french-medical-records-to-english): Translate French bilan sanguin, compte rendu and carnet de santé, with a French glossary.
- [German medical records to English](/translate/german-medical-records-to-english): Translate German Befund, Arztbrief and Impfpass, with a German glossary.
- [Dutch medical records to English](/translate/dutch-medical-records-to-english): Translate Dutch uitslag, ontslagbrief and vaccinatiebewijs, with a Dutch glossary.
- [Greek medical records to English](/translate/greek-medical-records-to-english): Translate Greek γενική αίματος, εξιτήριο and βιβλιάριο υγείας, with a Greek glossary.
- [Turkish medical records to English](/translate/turkish-medical-records-to-english): Translate Turkish tahlil sonucu, epikriz and aşı kartı, with a Turkish glossary.
- [Russian medical records to English](/translate/russian-medical-records-to-english): Translate Russian общий анализ крови, выписной эпикриз and vaccination certificates, with a Russian glossary.
- [Arabic medical records to English](/translate/arabic-medical-records-to-english): Translate Arabic medical reports, discharge reports and vaccination cards, with an Arabic glossary.
- [Chinese medical records to English](/translate/chinese-medical-records-to-english): Translate Chinese 检验报告, 出院小结 and 预防接种证, with a Mandarin glossary.
